sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "age" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "current_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "activity_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "training_frequency" INTEGER NULL, "preferred_units" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'metric', "preferred_language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en', "preferred_theme" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "is_onboarded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_onboarded" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "goal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "target_calories" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_protein_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "target_carbs_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "target_fat_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "calculated_bmr" REAL NOT NULL, "calculated_tdee" REAL NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_description" TEXT NOT NULL, "serving_weight_g" REAL NOT NULL, "calories_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_per100g" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber_per100g" REAL NULL, "prep_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'raw', "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_g" REAL NOT NULL, "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_name_ar" TEXT NULL, "calories" REAL NOT NULL, "protein" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs" REAL NOT NULL, "fat" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NULL, "servings" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "total_cooked_yield_g" REAL NULL, "total_calories" REAL NOT NULL, "total_protein" REAL NOT NULL, "total_carbs" REAL NOT NULL, "total_fat" REAL NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "food_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id), "food_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_g" REAL NOT NULL, "calories" REAL NOT NULL, "protein" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs" REAL NOT NULL, "fat" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NULL, "muscle_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'compound', "instructions" TEXT NULL, "instructions_ar" TEXT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_programs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_days" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "program_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_programs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "program_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workout_programs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "program_name" TEXT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "total_volume_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_completed_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "exercise_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "is_personal_record" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_personal_record" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_metrics" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "academy_progress" ("lesson_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "quiz_score" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lesson_id"));
